reviews.title: Used to have planes in it
reviews.text: I paid for this app and then they removed half the game! Less than impressed! Kid is very upset and no I’m not buying the plane game.

reviews.title: Too confusing
reviews.text: I can not tell what’s free, what isn’t, when I do pay for part of the app am I paying. Poor instructions on free trials, how to stop start, and purchase. When you make it hard for a parent with a screaming toddler, it’s not a good experience. Still confused.
